newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dharmala sets one-for-two rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Dharmala sets one-for-two rights issue.

text.p: Dharmala Holdings Ltd plans to raise about HK$194.4 million with a one-for-two rights issue, the company said on Monday.

Dharmala also will reduce its exposure to its loss-making agri-businesses in China and concentrate its resources on developing core businesses in financial services, the company said in an annoucement.
The rights will be priced at HK$0.50, a 40.48 percent discount to HK$0.84 -- the HK$0.85 closing price of its shares on May 22 less the proposed dividend of HK$0.01 per share.
It is also a discount of 31.50 percent to the theorectical ex-rights price of HK$0.73 per share after adjusting for the dividend, the announcement said.

Of the estimated minimum HK$191 million in net proceeds, about HK$90 million would be used to subscribe to convertible loan notes which are at the centre of the company's transfer deal of the agri-business to sister company PT Dharmala Intiutama (DIU).
